output.subject: A newsletter tool that finally respects code blocks
output.pitch: Hey, I'm building lettercraft — a newsletter platform for developers who hate fighting their editor over code formatting. We render syntax-highlighted, copyable code blocks in every major email client, verified across 14 clients with a public test matrix. Writers store posts as Markdown files in their own Git repo, so they keep full ownership and can export everything with one click. It’s already used by 1,100 technical writers in beta. If your audience cares about clean, developer-friendly publishing without lock-in, I’d love to get lettercraft in front of them. {APP_URL}
